read.thesis: CFO transition announcement with Q4 FY26 update: results will include an unplanned tariff-refund benefit, otherwise Q4 said to be in line with guidance; no supply or pricing disclosure.

triggers.label: One-time tariff refund benefit in Q4
triggers.quote: These results will include a benefit from tariff refunds that was not contemplated in the company’s previously provided guidance.

guidance.metric: Q4 FY26 results excluding tariff refund
guidance.value: generally in line with previously provided guidance
guidance.quote: Excluding this one-time benefit, fourth quarter results are expected to be generally in line with previously provided guidance.

red_flags.label: CFO departure ahead of Q4 results
red_flags.quote: Matthew Friend will step down as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer at that time
